articles.title: Global Markets Rally as Central Banks Signal Rate Stability

articles.content: Major indices climb while commodity prices ease, offering relief to consumers and businesses worldwide after months of uncertainty. articles.content: Delegates from 190 countries approve a new framework targeting net-zero pathways by 2045, with stronger accountability measures for major emitters. The agreement includes new reporting standards and financial support mechanisms for developing nations.
